passage.title: Stay Cool During the Heat Wave
passage.body: ¡Ola de calor! Mantente fresco. Bebe mucha agua. Quédate en la sombra. Use ventiladores y aire acondicionado para mantenerse fresco. 15-20 de julio.

items.stem: What does the advertisement encourage people to do?
choices: Use fans and air conditioners to cool down.
Stay indoors and avoid going outside.
Drink plenty of water and stay in the shade.
Go to the beach and enjoy the sun.
items.explanation: The advertisement encourages people to 'Use fans and air conditioners to cool down' as it states 'Use ventiladores y aire acondicionado para mantenerse fresco.'

passage.title: Heat Wave Warning
passage.body: ¡Advertencia de ola de calor! Hoy la temperatura máxima será de 36 grados Celsius. No olviden llevar agua. Eviten ejercicio intenso. Quedarse en lugares frescos. ¡Cuídense!

items.stem: What does the sign say is the highest temperature in the city today?
items.explanation: The sign states the temperature as 36 grados Celsius. The other choices are either incorrect or not mentioned in the text.
The sign says 'No olviden llevar agua'. 'Olvidar' in this context means 'to forget', so the correct interpretation is 'Do not forget to bring water'.
